text:
The 1990 predicted noise levels do not consider airport noise. These noise levels were not possible to predict because many parameters were changing and could not be predicted with any desirable accuracy, especially the percentages of jets and propeller driven aircraft. These percentages are continually changing in the direction of 100' jets.
Present regulations and continuing research will produce quieter aircraft by 1990. The Federal Aviation Administration has regulations which require all aircraft seeking new certification after 1969 to meet noise level requirements. In addition, the federal novernment and private industry are spending upwards of 37 million dollars a year to reduce the noise output of jets alone. This continuing effort to reduce aircraft noise levels will reduce the noise levels in the study area by 1990.
